description: Angular component for configuring color gradients in a widget, including form controls, gradient manipulation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: GradientComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing gradient settings in a widget, including form initialization, value writing, and gradient manipulation.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and subscribes to value changes to update the model.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions on component destruction.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Disables or enables the component.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given gradient setting object.

methods.name: generatePointers
methods.description: Generates HTML for gradient pointer indicators based on current form state.

methods.name: pointer
methods.description: Creates HTML for a single gradient pointer.

methods.name: linearGradient
methods.description: Returns a CSS style string for the current gradient.

methods.name: colorGradientControl
methods.description: Creates a form control for a gradient color.

methods.name: gradientListFormArray
methods.description: Getter for the gradient list form array.

methods.name: gradientListFormGroups
methods.description: Getter for the gradient list form groups.

methods.name: advancedGradientControl
methods.description: Creates a form control for an advanced gradient.

methods.name: advancedGradientListFormArray
methods.description: Getter for the advanced gradient list form array.

methods.name: advancedGradientListFormGroups
methods.description: Getter for the advanced gradient list form groups.

methods.name: trackByGradient
methods.description: Track function for gradient list items.

methods.name: removeGradient
methods.description: Removes a gradient from the list.

methods.name: gradientDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of gradients.

methods.name: addGradient
methods.description: Adds a new gradient to the list.

methods.name: updateModel
